blocks.text: Every Ugandan category is followed to any depth. A category is followed when its own name is Ugandan or is within two steps of one, so the walk does not wander into Kenya or Congo. Upload dates are those of each file's latest version. Media types are Commons' own: BITMAP is a raster picture (JPEG, PNG, GIF, TIFF, WebP), DRAWING is a vector drawing (SVG), VIDEO is WebM, OGV or MPG (Commons does not take MOV), AUDIO is OGG, WAV, FLAC or Opus, and OFFICE is PDF or DjVu.

items.b: 62,878 files sit in Ugandan categories on Commons, added by 4,175 accounts across 6,384 categories down to nine levels deep.
Uploads jumped from 3,924 files in 2023 to 8,489 in 2024 and 14,695 in 2025 — the biggest year on record — and 2026 already has 10,681. In 2025 alone, 102 GB was added.
Photo campaigns account for a large share: Wiki Loves Folklore (4,314); Wiki Loves Earth (3,960); Wiki Loves Africa (2,737); Wiki Loves Monuments (1,870).
50,051 files (80%) are used on no Wikimedia project. Putting good photographs into articles is the clearest way to add value.
The ten busiest uploaders added 33% of all files, while 2,189 accounts uploaded a single file — a pool of one-time contributors to invite back.
2,422 categories hold only one to four files and 58 are empty. Themes with least content: Education (306), Economy (513), Health (773).
Culture (10,161), History (8,844), Environment (3,909) lead the named themes.
